video.description:
Learn to explain how data travels from a push message to the right screen in the app: Notification Payload, UNUserNotificationCenter & Silent Push, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Notification Payload - The data inside a push message, such as the alert text, the badge number and your own values.
UNUserNotificationCenter - The system object your app uses to ask permission for, schedule and handle notifications.
Silent Push - A push message with no alert that wakes the app in the background to fetch new data.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Notification Payload, UNUserNotificationCenter & Silent Push in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Notification Payload, UNUserNotificationCenter, Silent Push 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Notification Payload - The data inside a push message, such as the alert text, the badge number and your own values.
한국어: Notification Payload: 알림 문구, 배지 숫자, 직접 넣은 값처럼 푸시 메시지 안에 들어 있는 데이터

UNUserNotificationCenter - The system object your app uses to ask permission for, schedule and handle notifications.
한국어: UNUserNotificationCenter: 앱이 알림 권한을 요청하고, 알림을 예약하고, 처리할 때 쓰는 시스템 객체

Silent Push - A push message with no alert that wakes the app in the background to fetch new data.
한국어: Silent Push: 알림 표시 없이 앱을 백그라운드에서 깨워 새 데이터를 가져오게 하는 푸시 메시지

landscape.hook: Can you explain Notification Payload, UNUserNotificationCenter and Silent Push in English?

dialogue.title: The wrong chat opens

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, a push arrives, but the app opens the wrong chat. Why?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Look at the notification payload. A notification payload is the data inside the push message.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, it is our own value. The app reads it from `info` when the user taps.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And who tells our app about the tap?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: UNUserNotificationCenter. It handles permission, scheduling and taps.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So `center` calls our delegate when the user taps the notification?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Set the delegate on UNUserNotificationCenter at launch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can the server refresh data before the user even taps?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, with a silent push. A silent push has no alert and wakes the app in the background.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does a silent push always arrive?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. The system may delay a silent push, so never depend on it.

dialogue.code:
import UserNotifications
let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
let info: [String: Any] = ["chatID": 42]
print(info["chatID"] ?? 0)
